title: Garden-Gnome / Mascot Presence Cam
dataSources: Festive lights (`festive:lights`), candy counter (`candy:counter`), countdown events (`countdown:event`), Santa tracker (`santa:tracker`).
app: Seasonal novelty feeds — smart Christmas-light power meters, a Halloween candy counter, advent/holiday countdowns, and festive trackers — streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and smart plugs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=candy:counter event=mascot_check
| stats latest(present) as present, latest(_time) as last_seen
| eval hours_missing=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1), missing=if(present="false",1,0)
description: Keeps a light-hearted watch on a garden gnome or mascot and alerts if it goes missing, a playful use of a camera.
value: It is deliberately silly, yet it doubles as a real presence check for any small outdoor object you care about.
implementation: Run object detection on a garden cam into `index=personal`; alert if the mascot disappears.
visualization: Single-value tile of mascot presence with time missing.
grandmaExplanation: It playfully keeps an eye on a garden gnome and tells you if it goes missing.
